The gaps between the instance cards and the button under them are one number again.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The instance list breathes evenly.** The cards sat 8px apart while the send button sat 16px below the last of them, so the button read as further away from the stack than the cards were from each other. Measured on a real popup with three instances, not assumed: 8, 8, then 16. Card to card, card to button and button to window edge are all 16 now. The options page draws the same cards with the same gap and had the same defect, so it changed with it rather than drifting apart from the popup.

## 📋 Notes

- No behaviour changed. If a click on a Click'n'Load button still opens a window of its own, the browser is running an older copy of this extension: an unpacked extension keeps the code it was loaded with until it is reloaded on the extensions page. 1.9.0 deleted that window outright, and there is no code left in this extension that can open one.
